query.query: SELECT properties.utm_source AS utm_source, quantile(0.05)(properties.session_time_ms) AS p5, quantile(0.25)(properties.session_time_ms) AS p25, quantile(0.50)(properties.session_time_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.75)(properties.session_time_ms) AS p75, quantile(0.95)(properties.session_time_ms) AS p95 FROM events WHERE event = 'custom_pageview' GROUP BY utm_source ORDER BY utm_source
